text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
I had a truly blissful time over this break.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: In the morning, I thoroughly read through fan letters overflowing with praise for me, and—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In the afternoon, we shot special bromides
to give to the kids who sent letters.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "At night, watched over by a framed picture of myself, I embark on a journey to the dream world..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And just like that,
I was able to refresh both mind and body!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I can put my heart and soul into today's training!
Bwahahahahaha!!
